name: swisscode
description: swisscode CLI: launch Claude Code with a named profile — switch between multiple Claude Pro/Max accounts, run the subscription proxy with rate-limit failover, use OpenRouter or custom providers.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run bundle && npm run build:web-embed
scripts.build:web-embed: npm run build -w @swisscode/web -w @swisscode/adapters -w @swisscode/core && rm -rf web && mkdir -p web/dist && cp ../web/server.mjs web/ && esbuild ../web/hostGuard.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=web/hostGuard.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="// Bundled from apps/web/hostGuard.mjs: the @swisscode/adapters import is inlined (workspace packages are not published)." && cp -r ../web/dist/client web/dist/client && cp -r ../web/dist/server web/dist/server
